title: Alleyway Names Obscured By Signboards

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. 40M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Central Station,
REPORT
Date September 5 19 38.

Subject (in full) Re O/R. File NO. 8689. Alleyway names obscured by signboards.

Made by Inspector Liu Wen Chao Forwarded by C.I. Barry Officer i/c.

Sir,

With reference to O/R. File NO. 8689, (Alleyway names obscured
by signboards), I beg to report that tours have been made by S.I.
Hsu Shu Cheng and C.P.S. 1266 and all signboards, obscuring the
various alleyway names in Central district, removed.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,
Inspector.

D.O."A".

FILE
11/9

Special Branch
Co Think action taken.
Now clear of all
places mentioned upper
Close
O/Hau
11/9

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
中央巡捕房，
报告
日期：1938年9月5日。

事由（全称）：关于 O/R. 档案第8689号。弄堂名称被招牌遮挡。

呈报人：督察刘文超 转呈人：警司 Barry 主管警官。

敬启者，

关于 O/R. 档案第8689号（弄堂名称被招牌遮挡），谨此报告，副督察徐树成及警员第1266号已进行巡查，中央区内所有遮挡各弄堂名称的招牌均已拆除。

此致
敬礼，

卑职，
督察。

分区警官“A”区。

归档
9月11日

特别支部
认为已采取行动。
上述提及的所有地点
现已清除
结案
O/Hau
9月11日

Louza Police Station,
REPORT
Date August 30, 1938.

Subject (in full) Re C/R File No.8689, Alleyway Names Obscured By

Made by Sub-Inspector Tulloch Forwarded by [Signature] C.I.

Sir,

With reference to C/R File No.8689, (Alleyway names
obscured by signboards). All signboards have been removed
which were obscuring alleyway names mentioned in the above
file in the Louza District, with the exception of the under-
mentioned lanes which have no name and are identified by the
lane number only:-

Fokien Road Lane No.215 not obscured.

FM. 2
G. 55M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY）
S. 5, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date August 26, 1930

Subject Alleyway Names Obscured by Signboards.

Made xx and Forwarded by D.S. McKeown.

With reference to the attached article entitled
"Signboards Obscure Alleyway Names", a tour of all streets
in Central and Louza Districts by C.D.C. 230 has revealed
that the names of the following alleyways are obscured by
signboards:-
Avenue Edward VII - Lane No. 524.
Pakhoi Road - Lanes Nos. 31 and 36.
Canton Road - Lanes Nos. 108, 352, 369, 380 and 517.
Foochow Road - Lanes Nos. 252, 337, 384, 446, 486, 531 and 614.
Kiukiang Road - Lane No. 414.
Nanking Road - Lanes Nos. 208, 338, 374 and 778.
Yu Ya Ching Road - Lanes Nos. 54 and 562.
Kwangse Road - Lane No. 428.
Chekiang Road - Lanes Nos. 63, 108, 118, 190 and 220.
Fokien Road - Lanes Nos. 141, 194, 215 and 226.
Shantung Road - Lanes Nos. 9, 24, 61, 99, 140, 180 and 338.
Honan Road - Lanes Nos. 194, 466, 646, 426 and 494.
Lloyd Road - Lanes Nos. 36 and 52.
Amoy Road - Lane No. 76.
Kingloongka - Lane No. 48.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（批：JMcKeown/ D. S.）
（批：DO"A"）
（批：As 'phoned）
（批：HP）

FM. 2

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部登记室）
S. 5, 特别支部。
报告
日期：1930年8月26日

事由：弄堂名称被招牌遮挡。

呈报人 xx 及 转呈人：副警司 McKeown。

关于所附题为“招牌遮挡弄堂名称”的文章，经中央侦探课第230号对中央区和老闸区所有街道进行巡查，发现下列弄堂的名称被招牌遮挡：-

爱多亚路 - 第524号弄。
北河南路 - 第31号和36号弄。
广东路 - 第108、352、369、380和517号弄。
福州路 - 第252、337、384、446、486、531和614号弄。
九江路 - 第414号弄。
南京路 - 第208、338、374和778号弄。
虞洽卿路 - 第54和562号弄。
广西路 - 第428号弄。
浙江路 - 第63、108、118、190和220号弄。
福建路 - 第141、194、215和226号弄。
山东路 - 第9、24、61、99、140、180和338号弄。
河南路 - 第194、466、646、426和494号弄。
劳合路 - 第36和52号弄。
厦门路 - 第76号弄。
Kingloongka (音译) - 第48号弄。

侦探长（特别支部）。

（批注：JMcKeown/ 副警司。）
（批注：分区警官“A”区）
（批注：如电话所述）
（批注：HP）

page_data.en:
Sin Jan Pao (Evening Edition) dated July 29 :-
SIGNBOARDS OBSCURE ALLEYWAY NAMES
When one desires to visit a friend,
it is necessary first to find the alleyway, but the names
of alleyways are often obscured by signboards. This
practice should not be allowed
page_data.zh:
7月29日《新闻报》（晚刊）：-
招牌遮挡弄堂名称
当人们欲拜访朋友时，
需先找到弄堂，但弄堂的名称
常被招牌遮挡。此种
做法不应被允许
